# Browser vendor assets

- PDF.js 3.11.174 (`pdf.min.js`, `pdf.worker.min.js`) — Apache-2.0 — https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/
- ExcelJS 4.4.0 (`exceljs.min.js`) — MIT — https://github.com/exceljs/exceljs
- Bootstrap 5.3.3 (`bootstrap.min.css`, `bootstrap.bundle.min.js`) — MIT — https://getbootstrap.com/

These files are pinned local copies used by the LAN-only tools. Runtime pages load them from `/vendor/` rather than public CDNs.
